why: Krish, 2026-11-17 (learning upgrade-the-edit-style, 17 Oct): "have a bank of styles that we can draw from ... The background of the person has also been treated when he's talking so it doesn't look too amateur." Krish, 2026-11-18: "I don't want 300 different choices in the UI so figure out how." Treatments are applied by rule from what each beat or still is for. Nobody picks one: Krish's only visible choice stays the look (his Pick a style press), which sets their strength through style.energy.

source.name: EffectCraft
source.use: reference for effect names, parameters and defaults; behaviour is rebuilt in the renderer, no Rust is vendored (docs/ve/sources/effectcraft.md)

subject-matte.what: a per-frame matte of Krish on his take (SAM 2.1 Tiny in EffectCraft; ve's model is the card's choice), refined at the edge

matte-choke.what: tightens or softens the matte's edge so hair and hands do not smear (F53)

exposure.what: darkens the background plate behind the matte

gaussian-blur.what: softens the background plate behind the matte

rim-light.what: a soft glow from the matte's edge outwards, in brand mint, behind him

grain.what: fine seeded film grain, the same seed for a still and its render frame

glow.what: a glow on bright type or a number, colour channels, composite on top

duotone.what: maps a photo to the brand ink and cream (shadows to ink_deep, highlights to cream)

highlight-sweep.what: one band of light that crosses a proof line or receipt once

channel-split.what: a short red and cyan split on graphics only, a few frames on a hit

vignette.what: a soft edge darkening that pulls the eye to the centre

subject-lift.for: Krish on his take, or his cutout on a face-led cover

number-glow.for: a beat whose device shows a number or a chart

receipt-paper.for: a beat whose device shows a receipt, document or proof line

still-grain.for: every still's ground, so flat colour never reads as a template

still-duotone.for: a photograph on a carousel slide or Notes image

still-glow.for: the one number or key word on a still

still-sweep.for: a receipt or proof line on a still, frozen mid-sweep

video.order: subject-lift first, then device, then role; capped at limits.max_treatments_per_beat
